T1.limitations: Joins exact case-folded names.primary/route identities; the frozen <30-degree deflection-angle stroke criterion is not implemented.

T2.limitations: Identifies links whose connector neighbors are non-named only; emitted length is the in-tract link length, not adjacent carriageway length within 2 km.

T3.limitations: Uses provided road_flags/level_rules as grade-separation evidence; it does not enumerate geometric crossing pairs without shared connectors.

T4.limitations: Uses tract-local connector-degree product as a centrality proxy; this is not sampled shortest-path edge betweenness.

T5.limitations: Building-centroid distance to any provided roads-unfiltered geometry; centroids are assigned strictly within the provided tract polygons.

redundancy_flags.handling: all channels retained; flags disclosed for downstream merge handling; no silent drops

scope.correlation: pairwise-complete Pearson r over the official tract set
scope.vif_source: reports/ideas-orthogonality.json; VIF on its preregistered complete-case matrix
